data.retirementDetails: Como parte do seu compromisso com a ação climática e a gestão responsável de emissões, a Brasilseg Companhia de Seguros (CNPJ 28.196.889/0001-43) está compensando 1.985 toneladas de CO₂ equivalente (tCO₂e), relativas aos escopos 1, 2 e 3 de suas operações no ano de 2024. Deste total, 993 tCO₂e estão sendo compensadas por meio da aquisição e aposentadoria de créditos de carbono do Projeto AGROCORTEX REDD+, certificado pela Verra, que contribui diretamente para a conservação da floresta amazônica e a proteção da biodiversidade. Com essa iniciativa, a Brasilseg reforça seu compromisso com a integridade ambiental e com ações climáticas de alto impacto positivo e resiliente ao clima.

data.retirementDetails: Following our carbon neutral achievement during 2020, Sky Trails Zambia has decided to achieve Climate Positivity during 2021 by offsetting 10% more than emitted for the first 6 months of 2021 through our partnership with BCP (BioCarbon Partners). The year 2020 saw unprecedented challenges to the aviation industry on a global scale, and neither Sky Trails nor any other Zambian commercial aviation company were spared! Turnover dropped to around 25% of 2019 levels; despite these huge challenges we were determined to prioritize our environmental commitments and continued to offset all our carbon emissions during 2020. With a gradual recovery during 2021, we decided to create more positive climate impact by offsetting 10% more than neutrality.

data.retirementDetails: Sky Trails Zambia has now completed a full year of carbon free operations thanks to our partnership with BCP and their carbon credits. The year 2020 saw unprecedented challenges to the aviation industry on a global scale, and neither Sky Trails nor any other Zambian commercial aviation company were spared!  Turnover dropped to around 25% of 2019 levels;  despite these huge challenges we were determined to prioritize out environmental commitments and continued to offset all our carbon emissions. We hope that 2021 will bring a gradual recovery which will increase the carbon credits we buy and hence provide further support to the invaluable work done by BCP..
